entry_state: The awards parent is complete, including the signed participating-tax allocation and its separation from reported profit and journals. Control, acquisition, inventory elimination and functional versus presentation currency have been taught. The foreign-subsidiary lifecycle now reaches the two loss-of-control alternatives and their cash/equity table; its remaining cash and equity reconciliation continues on 236. The lifecycle parent and loss-of-control subsection are still pending.
exit_state: The foreign-subsidiary lifecycle and its group bindings are complete. The ordinary versus qualifying net-investment loan cases preserve identical cash/equity 212 with distinct profit/OCI, and identified transaction matching prevents unsupported eliminations. Restatement before translation has begun: monetary balances remain nominal while dated nonmonetary amounts and equity need the relevant indices. Its worked IAS29 example continues on 242; that section and its monetary-loss display remain pending.
findings: Saved actual ascending image reading supplies 236–238 without claiming a second read; 239–241 were then actually viewed in ascending order. The disposal equity bridges and book bindings are complete, as are the loan-exposure and transaction-matching sections. The purchasing-power example is incomplete at 241 and is deferred. No new confirmed manuscript defect; source/applicability and independent/domain/human acceptance limits remain.

equation.exposition_role: Whole-period equity bridge for the full-sale branch.
equation.symbols_units_domain: All five amounts are USD; 300 is opening equity, 24 acquisition NCI, 58.8 profit, 2.2 OCI and 31.2 disposal NCI.
equation.assumptions_timing: Uses the stated A/O/R/D synthetic chronology and proportionate NCI; no extra tax or valuation effects are introduced.
equation.source_and_equality: 300+24+58.8+2.2−31.2 equals 353.8 and agrees with the full-sale closing cash shown immediately above.
equation.interpretation: NCI’s period OCI survives in attribution even though the entire closing NCI balance has been removed.
equation.transition: Leads to the warning that equal final equity can conceal wrong intermediate goodwill or reserve treatment.
